title: A trader docked at The Experiment strips its off-role starter modules (Pulse Laser I, Mining Laser I, Gas Harvester I) into its storage there
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 01:23 UTC (F17: stripping off-role starters deploys at once in parallel batches; F40 alarm Module Fit & Purity: 68 of 85 traders carry an off-role starter; table ship_modules 01:23 UTC: pulse_laser_i 64, mining_laser_i 32, gas_harvester_i 2 on traders). A trader never fights (stance flee, card) and never gathers (F23): the modules take cpu and power a later cargo or defence module uses. The form of Apophis's strip-mining-laser-krynn: one docked stop, unfit then store all, once a pilot, gated to the ships already docked at The Experiment (requires.docked_at; the Bursar desk beside it keeps them there), no fuel, no buy.
